title: A verification follow-up can report binding_deferred after the same run's settlement notice
outcome: A test-run wait follow-up delivered after a verification record has settled describes the current settlement or explicitly marks the earlier pending decision as historical. The owning session can identify the record and its run without mistaking a stale wait snapshot for an unresolved verification.
acceptance: For the reported run and wait, trace the source of the pending follow-up and settled notice using the available host or artifact evidence, and distinguish observed delivery order from any inferred queueing race.

When a run's verification follow-up was formed while binding was deferred but the same registration settles before the follow-up is delivered, the later prompt either names the settled record or clearly labels the pending statement as historical. A genuinely unresolved binding still reports its pending reason.

Behavioural regression coverage exercises the ordering on one run and verifies the record identity and outcome remain unchanged, while preserving the existing wait and settlement delivery behavior for still-pending runs.
